hearing.quote: Grand Lake gets my yes because the conditions are real and the record is public — not because the money is easy.
hearing.actionAsked: Record the YES vote and hold the milestone and audit conditions as written.

hearing.quote: The closeout is published, the renewal ordinance is transmitted, and the standard holds at 23 days. Renewal is council's call — I won't call it before they do.
hearing.actionAsked: Publish the C114 closeout and transmit the charter renewal ordinance to the C115 agenda, preserving the West Oakland business-and-resident scope and the 23-day processing standard, without claiming renewal before council action.

hearing.quote: Relief without accountability is merely an expenditure; District 8 votes YES because the Chen-Vega audit protocols guarantee that every dollar deployed in Grand Lake is tracked, verified, and earned.
hearing.actionAsked: Vote YES on INIT-009 with mandatory Chen-Vega milestone reporting and audit criteria fully preserved

hearing.quote: When public funds are bound by enforceable audits and transparent milestones, investment delivers real results rather than empty promises.
hearing.actionAsked: Vote YES on INIT-009 with Chen-Vega audit and milestone reporting conditions intact

hearing.quote: I support the investment, but the public should be able to see where the money is assigned and how people will reach the corridors it serves.
hearing.actionAsked: Record the full-council vote and publish the Chinatown and Uptown appropriation tracks, timeline, and transit-access planning.

hearing.quote: Accountability triggers make the difference between an investment and an open checkbook; because those audit milestones are intact, I vote yes.
hearing.actionAsked: Enforce all Chen-Vega audit protocols and require milestone compliance before releasing commercial stabilization disbursements.

hearing.quote: The people who called 911 get to see their own numbers, in their own neighborhood, before this program takes one more step.
hearing.actionAsked: Conduct and document the D3 East Oakland community briefing with district-level and Fruitvale data this cycle; keep expansion held until afterward; report the D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review as directed, not completed.

hearing.quote: I support the proposal with its safeguards intact; the low-severity improvement flag is a reason to monitor, not to skip a recorded decision.
hearing.actionAsked: Record my YES vote and retain all milestone and audit conditions.

dispositions.note: C115: C114 closeout publication ordered and charter renewal ordinance transmitted; business-and-resident scope and 23-day standard preserved pending council action.
C115: D3 East Oakland briefing execution and documentation required; expansion held, with D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review still incomplete.
C115: Schematics delivery and documented Fruitvale review required; further design advancement awaits a public comment-and-response record.
C115: Evidence-file milestone review ordered; no construction milestone pass declared, and remediation, hotline, dust-control, and workforce oversight continue.
C115: Placement-gap analysis and adjustment plan required for publication with explicit West Oakland and Fruitvale review; implementation continues.
C115: Recorded full-council decision scheduled with Chen-Vega milestone and audit conditions intact; no vote outcome claimed.
C115: Recorded committee decision scheduled; legal-support analysis must be published before the vote, with no outcome claimed in advance.
C115: Legislation filed on current Ivy Hill evidence—low crime, slow trade, and soured mood—with no manufactured emergency premise.

gavel.quote: West Oakland’s fund keeps its business-and-resident scope, its 23-day standard, and a renewal decision made openly by the council.
